first.rationale: Competitive entry pricing creates an immediate risk among price-sensitive SMBs, and prior evidence supports targeted promotional pricing; however, its prior readout pooled redefined cohorts, so verification is required before committing. A small guarded test can target price-sensitive SMBs while measuring qualified revenue, conversion quality, discount dependence, and early retention. Onboarding deterioration is also material, so memory_86 is being verified as the principal alternative.
